name: Firefly DL FFY-U3-16S2M-S-DL

sources.title: Firefly DL (Legacy), model FFY-U3-16S2M-S-DL (Teledyne Vision Solutions product page)
sources.covers: resolution, frame rate, sensor (Sony IMX296), pixel size, sensor format, shutter, mono, S-mount, interface, exposure range, ADC, size, mass, power; the model list (status NRND)

note: A tiny mono USB3 Vision camera with on-camera neural-network inference and an S-mount (a legacy product: the page lists the model as "NRND", not recommended for new designs). Sold without a lens, so no FOV, f-number or focus is stated: the imager has no FOV and the library uses its labelled default until the user enters the chosen lens (or a calibration). Sony IMX296, 1440 x 1080, 1/2.9", pixel size "3.45" (micrometres), maximum frame rate 60 fps; ADC 10 bit; format not listed (null). Exposure "29.0 us to 30.0 S". power_w is the stated maximum, 2.2 W (5 V via USB). size_mm is the stated 27 x 27 x 14.5 mm (W x H x L), entered as [14.5, 27, 27]. The page states no trigger input (4 bi-directional GPIO), so sync is null.
